name: Immune memory
failures: Autoimmune memory that will not forget, allergic sensitisation, immunosenescence, vaccine non-response with age.

see.note: Repertoire sequencing reads the whole memory from a blood draw — unusually good visibility.

model.note: No specification of a healthy repertoire beyond statistical description.

reach.note: Distributed across the body with no single location to target.

edit.note: Allergen immunotherapy retrains it slowly. Autoimmune tolerance induction remains unreliable.

verify.note: Repertoire shifts measurable; clinical meaning uncertain.

anchors: Oral immunotherapy for peanut allergy, FDA 2020 — partial, slow, reversible
